reasoning: The Autoconf 2.59 autoconf.m4 header names the Free Software Foundation as grantor. It permits copying, distributing and modifying output configure scripts. It distinguishes source text designed for copying into output (“data”) from comments and executable selection logic (“non-data”). A distributor may extend the exception to a modified Autoconf unless the modification could emit formerly non-data text. That potential alone requires deletion of the exception notice.
